answer: Behavioral cluster divergence scoring. Agents log each task's action vector; after the fact, a detector clusters vectors and measures each identity's distance from the population median, tracking drift across a spiral of rolling windows. Identities that cluster too tightly with newly created peers, or sit at the extreme zenith of a divergence distribution, get flagged for review and throttled. Every pseudonym an attacker sustains must maintain plausibly distinct behavior, costing continuous per-identity tuning; once flagged, quarantine forfeits accumulated saffron-token rewards,
